P11.rationale: The page displays bold percentage figures ('100%') as typographic callouts rather than actual data visualisations (charts, graphs, before/after comparisons with axes or cost-math tables), so numbers are present but not bound to real visual data structures.

P12.rationale: Both columns have large areas of white space with sparse text blocks and no visual elements (charts, images, icons, or infographics) to fill the sheet, resulting in an under-filled layout far from dense magazine-quality editorial density.
